{{Top|leg}}
The '''''buy'ce''''', or helmet, was a piece of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] or ''beskar'gam'', that protected the wearer's head. It was the most important piece of a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian's]] armor, as well as being a symbol of their people.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
